task_description: Improve PWABuilder/Lighthouse scores for the live public frontend (Public/frontend-v6, chhath.shaharpura.com) with three targeted low-risk changes audited against the live site: (1) allow Cloudflare Web Analytics in the CSP to clear a real console error / Best-Practices penalty, (2) add a single semantic <h1> to the default (premium) skin's home route which currently has zero h1s (SEO + A11y), (3) strengthen og:title/twitter:title and upgrade the social preview image/card (SEO / social). Frontend-only, public-only, scoped to Public/frontend-v6. Keep npm run check 0/0, npm test green, npm run build within the JS budget, and the generated manifest unchanged.
